notes.title: New game, same chaotic energy
notes.content: [p]Hey friends! [/p][p]It’s Jacob — the dev behind [i]Bass Monkey[/i] and [i]The Last Humble Bee[/i].[/p][p]I’ve been quietly working on a new game for the past 6 months, and it’s finally time to announce it: [/p][p][b]Raccoon Crime Spree[/b]![/p][p]Play as a raccoon that commits crimes — steal cars, boop pedestrians, and hide in garbage cans.[/p][p]It’s coming to Steam, and you can wishlist it here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3661980/"][/dynamiclink]If you enjoyed my past games, I think you’ll get a kick out of this one. [/p][p]—Jacob[/p]

notes.title: Announcing my new game: The Last Humble Bee – Play the Demo for Free!
notes.content:
Hi all!

How are my fellow Bass Monkeys doing??

It’s been a while, but I’ve actually been hard at work on my new game, The Last Humble Bee!

[previewyoutube=UyjPgUYQpH0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










And now, I’m super thrilled to share that you can now play the FREE DEMO.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190150/The_Last_Humble_Bee/

If you’re familiar, the Last Humble Bee is like the “Bee Movie” meets “Hades”…it’s a fast-paced, heart-BUZZING rogue like game where you play as a bumble bee saving the bees from Hell!

Similar to Bass Monkey, I’m making the music myself! The soundtrack contains sampled sounds from REAL BUMBLEBEES! But don’t worry, no bees were harmed in the making of this game (or the soundtrack) lol.

As always, feel free to [url=https://twitter.com/YakobSoup]follow me on twitter[/url] to keep up with game updates, and [url=https://www.yakobsoup.com/humble-bee-email-list]join my email list [/url]for free stuff and news. I’m planning for a full game release in 2025 so I’m still hard at work on the game 😊
Best,
Jacob

notes.title: Bass Monkey will be released for FREE on June 2nd!
notes.content:
Bass Monkey will be released totally for FREE on June 2nd!

I've spent over a year on this chill hack and slash arcade game, and I just hope that it spreads much silliness and joy as possible.

notes.title: Bass Monkey Demo -- Watch the Developer Play
notes.content:
I'll be playing through the demo for my game, [b]Bass Monkey![/b]

Don't hesitate to reach out,[b] Wishlist the game[/b], or [b]download the demo[/b] to give it a try!

Assemble your band (up to 4 players) and play as a bass swingin' monkey or guitar swingin' panda! Collect bananas, smack away your fans, and get a high score before the album ends!
